summary: Iteration 40: tested Provider Templates (list/apply), Cost Budget Projection, Sparkline Tooltip and Rotation Alert Retry Cap. Backend pytest: 12/13 passing. Frontend Routing page: all 5 template cards render; projection chip 'PROJ · $0.0478' shown on emergent; sparkline hover reveals tooltip 'YYYY-MM-DD · $X.XXXX' with dashed guide + point, hides on mouse leave; applying 'balanced' fires success + per-warning toasts and updates task-route dropdowns to emergent/groq/gemini/openai. ONE CRITICAL BACKEND BUG FOUND: rotation_alert_attempts counter never accumulates past 1 because services/provider_health.py:_write_health projects only {status, rotation_alert_sent} from prior doc — rotation_alert_attempts is missing from the projection so `prior.get('rotation_alert_attempts') or 0` always reads as 0. Effect: the '3-strike retry cap' feature does NOT work as specified; on a persistent red state each fresh green→red cycle just resets attempts to 1 and tries once, and the log-warn 'gave up after 3 failed sends' never fires from the normal flow. Everything else in the feature set is correct.

critical.issue: Rotation-alert retry cap is broken. The `prior` find_one at line 106-109 projects only {'_id': 0, 'status': 1, 'rotation_alert_sent': 1} — rotation_alert_attempts is NOT included in the projection. So `attempts = int(prior.get('rotation_alert_attempts') or 0)` is always 0 regardless of what's in the DB. When _send_rotation_alert returns False, new_attempts is written as 1 but the next green→red cycle re-reads attempts as 0 again. The `if new_attempts >= 3: log.warning('gave up after 3 failed sends', ...)` branch is unreachable via the normal flow. Fix: add 'rotation_alert_attempts': 1 to the find_one projection.

rca of the issue: Bug: rotation-alert retry cap does not cap. Reproduce: seed provider_health with {status:'green', rotation_alert_attempts:2, rotation_alert_sent:false}, then invoke provider_health._write_health(uid, provider, 'red', ...) with a _send_rotation_alert that returns False. Expected rotation_alert_attempts=3. Actual: 1. RCA: services/provider_health.py:106 projects {'_id':0,'status':1,'rotation_alert_sent':1} — omitting rotation_alert_attempts. The subsequent `attempts = int(prior.get('rotation_alert_attempts') or 0)` reads None→0, so new_attempts is 0+1=1 no matter the stored value. Mitigation: `{'_id':0,'status':1,'rotation_alert_sent':1,'rotation_alert_attempts':1}`. Impact: HIGH — the entire spec bullet '(4) Rotation Alert Retry Cap — give up after 3 failed Resend deliveries' is non-functional; a broken Resend service will keep the retry counter stuck at 1 forever and every fresh green→red flip will call _send_rotation_alert once.
